sermon.title: Prelude to Miraculous Event 10/29/2017
sermon.speaker: Pastor David G. Kincer
sermon.summary: Pastor David G. Kincer teaches Acts 10: God prepares both Cornelius, a God-fearing Gentile, and Peter through an angel and a vision. Peter learns God is no respecter of persons, and as he preaches, the Holy Ghost falls on the listeners, who speak in tongues and magnify God before being water baptized—showing the baptism of the Spirit as a supernatural, empowering event God gives to whom he will.
sermon.transcript_source: This transcript comes from YouTube’s automatic English captions, which supply the timing and the words. Punctuation, capitalization and paragraphing were added from the speaker’s pauses and then corrected by hand, and obvious caption errors (names, Bible references) were fixed; his wording was not rewritten. “[unclear]” marks a word or name that was not clear. Editor notes: Transcript begins at 0:01. Points to check: Pentecost crowd from “15 different nations”; “25 percent of Catholics” spirit-filled since the 1960s; Catholics filled in 1968. Sensitive content kept as spoken: people who never heard of Christ who fear God and do right are “accepted”; Cornelius “an unbeliever” who rejected Christ “like the Jews”, “twice the children of hell”; Jews “thought they were God's chosen people”, Christians as “God's elect of the elect”; America “worship[s] ministers”; Catholic “statues Mary statues”; Chinese church leaders who “read it different”; ministers riding “Rolls-Royce chariots”.

faqs.question: What did the angel tell Cornelius?
What did Peter see?
faqs.answer: Unclean animals let down from heaven.

faqs.question: Is God a respecter of persons?
Who is accepted with God in every nation?
faqs.answer: Those who fear him and work righteousness.

faqs.question: When did the Holy Ghost fall?
What did they do when filled?
faqs.answer: Spoke with tongues and magnified God.

faqs.question: What changed in the apostles?
faqs.answer: They never ran; they died as martyrs.
